session: 2026-09-01 Session C (final directive) — authoritative candidate populations, the 85122 render test, worker-count provenance, the closeout truth surfaces, the wiki-artifact verification, the domain cutover to meanwhileusa.com, the GitHub rename follow-through, the brand identity, the Ask model switch, the admin control centre and the staging environment

workstreams.title: ITEM F code half — one PUBLIC_SITE_ORIGIN, three named origins that never collapse into each other, 32 call sites migrated, the legacy host 301'd, and a sweep guard that refuses a re-hardcoded host
concurrencyEvidence: Ran FIRST and alone, on the integration branch, deliberately: it is the shared load-bearing file every other lane imports. Three lanes writing their own copy of the production origin is precisely the defect ITEM F exists to remove, so this one is serialized AHEAD of the fan-out rather than fanned out with it.

workstreams.title: ITEMS A, B, E — the authoritative AZ/NH/NJ candidate and contest populations acquired as corpora and the registries regenerated from them, the 85122 new-ZIP readiness check raised to an application-render test, and worker obligation/occurrence/disposition counts read back through the read-only Postgres instrument
concurrencyEvidence: Own git worktree at .claude/worktrees/sc-l1-populations on branch sc-final/l1-populations, own node_modules, own agent process, dispatched in the same round as w2-w5.

workstreams.title: ITEMS C, D — the owner audit package rebuilt so no acceptance claim points at a session report, the full Item-5 denominator table derived from canonical state, the test-count denominator resolved and persisted in the gate record, and the already-merged Morris wiki artifact verified rather than re-acquired
concurrencyEvidence: Own git worktree at .claude/worktrees/sc-l2-closeout on branch sc-final/l2-closeout, own node_modules, own agent process. It writes named PENDING placeholders for the lanes still running rather than waiting on them, which is what keeps it off the critical path.

workstreams.title: ITEMS G, K — the GitHub rename followed through in remotes, Netlify's repository link, workflows and runbooks, and the Ask surface moved from claude-opus-5 to claude-sonnet-5 with the request shape corrected, token budgets recounted and the reader-answerability suite re-run per question against both models

dependencyReasons.w0-origins-base: ITEM K's production confirmation must target PUBLIC_SITE_ORIGIN, and the workflow and runbook edits in ITEM G touch the same observer target the origins module now supplies. Proven by the produces/consumes handoff on public-site-origin, not by prose.

concurrencyEvidence: Own git worktree at .claude/worktrees/sc-l3-domain-model on branch sc-final/l3-domain-model, own node_modules, own agent process. The w0 edge is a handoff already satisfied at dispatch time — w0 was committed before the fan-out — so the edge orders the work without serializing the wall clock.

workstreams.title: ITEM J — the Meanwhile identity installed: the --font-record and --mark tokens dark-first with the scoping rule, EB Garamond self-hosted so no reader's address reaches Google, one Logo component consumed by every brand surface, the map pin removed, icons and OG, and the undeclared-token sweep the --border defect named

dependencyReasons.w0-origins-base: The OG and canonical URLs are built from PUBLIC_SITE_ORIGIN rather than a literal host, and tests/origins.test.ts refuses a re-hardcoded one. Proven by the produces/consumes handoff on public-site-origin.

concurrencyEvidence: Own git worktree at .claude/worktrees/sc-l4-brand on branch sc-final/l4-brand, own node_modules, own agent process, own local production build and Playwright captures on its own port.

workstreams.title: ITEMS H, I — the owner control centre at the admin origin with a server-side gate, an aggregate-only durable data plane and the decision intent path, and the staging environment at the staging origin with database isolation, a STAGING_RENDER target, a second observer and a promotion gate proved in both directions without moving main

dependencyReasons.w0-origins-base: ADMIN_ORIGIN and STAGING_RENDER_ORIGIN are declared there, deliberately as separate concepts from the production origin so no caller can overload one to select the other's behaviour. Proven by the produces/consumes handoff on admin-origin and staging-render-origin.

concurrencyEvidence: Own git worktree at .claude/worktrees/sc-l5-admin-staging on branch sc-final/l5-admin-staging, own node_modules, own agent process. netlify.toml is edited here and nowhere else after w0 closed it, so the two never hold it at once.
